title: archive: follow the simple tree and Ubuntu releases under ubuntu/
description: This seems mostly sane, should be gone over in detail though.
commit_message:
archive: follow the simple tree and Ubuntu releases under ubuntu/

Both scripts hardcode the pre-ADT-1911 layout.

archive-image sent Ubuntu releases to the wrong place: the first case
branch matches $CDIMAGE_FULL/releases/* and archives to old-releases,
but Ubuntu releases now live at full/ubuntu/releases/, which fell through
to the generic per-project branch and landed in old-images.  Match both
forms, and take the destination from everything after the "releases"
component so old-releases keeps its flat layout either way.

Both also derived the simple tree's pool as $CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/.pool.  The
pool sits beside the series directory, so it nested along with it, and
archiving anything published since then globbed an empty old pool and
exited 1 after the coherence check had already passed the image as valid.
archive-image now takes the pool from the image's own directory, which
covers both layouts; archive-point-release picks the tree root by looking
for the release under ubuntu/ first, and now says so rather than running
on with an empty $relname when it finds neither.

Verified the branch routing and pool derivation against both layouts for
full/releases, full/ubuntu/releases, full/kubuntu/releases, simple/ubuntu
and simple.

archive-point-release: fix the shell defects in the pool loop

Not layout drift -- these predate it, and they mean the loop cannot have
run successfully as written:

  - "$$images_source" expands $$ to the shell's PID, so the symlink path
    was "<pid>images_source/<file>";
  - "$symilnk" is a typo for "$symlink", so the mv was handed an empty
    argument;
  - $images_base is never assigned anywhere in this script, so both
    mv_checksum calls got an empty image name.

Derive images_base from the file being archived, with its extension
stripped, since mv_checksum greps for "*$image." in SHA256SUMS.

Worth deciding whether this script is still a live tool.  The whole case
block below the "more work to be done" exit 0 is unreachable, and these
defects surviving suggests the loop above it is not exercised either.
diff:
diff --git a/bin/archive-image b/bin/archive-image
index 6f83f55..8b99173 100755
--- a/bin/archive-image
+++ b/bin/archive-image
@@ -84,15 +84,21 @@ images_source=$(dirname "$images_arg")
 
 case $images_source in
 
-    $CDIMAGE_FULL/releases/*)
-        # Special case: releases/ also go to old-releases, not old-images
+    $CDIMAGE_FULL/releases/* | $CDIMAGE_FULL/ubuntu/releases/*)
+        # Special case: releases/ also go to old-releases, not old-images.
+        # Ubuntu releases nest under ubuntu/ since ADT-1911; those published
+        # before it are still directly under full/releases/.  Both forms are
+        # Ubuntu and both belong in old-releases, so match them here rather
+        # than letting the nested one fall through to the per-project branch.
         # Coherence check
-        if ! echo "$images_source" | grep -q "full\/releases\/[a-z]\+\/\(beta\|release\)"; then
+        if ! echo "$images_source" | grep -q "full\/\(ubuntu\/\)\?releases\/[a-z]\+\/\(beta\|release\)"; then
             echo "Not a valid image to archive."
             exit 1
         fi
 
-        images_dest="$OLD_RELEASES${images_source##$CDIMAGE_FULL/releases}"
+        # Strip everything up to and including the "releases" component, so
+        # old-releases keeps the flat layout it has always had.
+        images_dest="$OLD_RELEASES${images_source#*/releases}"
         # We remove both the release and beta suffix
         images_dest="${images_dest%%release}"
         images_dest="${images_dest%%beta}"
@@ -145,10 +151,14 @@ case $images_source in
             exit 1
         fi
 
-        images_source_pool="$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/.pool"
+        # The pool sits beside the series directory, so it nests along
+        # with it: www/simple/ubuntu/.pool for a release under ubuntu/, and
+        # www/simple/.pool for one published before the nesting.
+        images_source_pool="$(dirname "$images_source")/.pool"
 
-        images_dest="$OLD_RELEASES${images_source##$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE}"
-        images_dest_pool="$OLD_RELEASES${images_source_pool##$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE}"
+        # old-releases stays flat, as archive-point-release also assumes.
+        images_dest="$OLD_RELEASES/$(basename "$images_source")"
+        images_dest_pool="$OLD_RELEASES/.pool"
 
         if [ ! -d "$images_dest" ] || [ ! -d "$images_dest_pool" ]; then
             echo "Destination directory non-existing, creating..."
diff --git a/bin/archive-point-release b/bin/archive-point-release
index 3a7ebb9..03c341e 100755
--- a/bin/archive-point-release
+++ b/bin/archive-point-release
@@ -75,7 +75,20 @@ OLD_IMAGES="/srv/cdimage.ubuntu.com/old-images"
 OLD_RELEASES="/srv/cdimage.ubuntu.com/www/old-releases"
 
 release=$(echo "$1" | cut -f1-2 -d.)
-relname=$(readlink "$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/$release")
+
+# Releases nest under ubuntu/ since ADT-1911; those published before it are
+# still at the tree root.  Everything below works within one of the two.
+if [ -e "$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/ubuntu/$release" ]; then
+	SIMPLE_ROOT="$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/ubuntu"
+else
+	SIMPLE_ROOT="$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE"
+fi
+
+relname=$(readlink "$SIMPLE_ROOT/$release")
+if [ -z "$relname" ]; then
+	echo "No $release release found under $SIMPLE_ROOT."
+	exit 1
+fi
 
 mkdir -p "$OLD_RELEASES/$relname" "$OLD_RELEASES/.pool"
 
@@ -83,22 +96,22 @@ point_release="$1"
 if ! echo "$point_release" | grep -q '\..*\.'
 then
 	point_release="${point_release}.0"
-	cp -a "$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/$relname/.htaccess" \
+	cp -a "$SIMPLE_ROOT/$relname/.htaccess" \
 		"$OLD_RELEASES/$relname/.htaccess"
 else
 	if ! grep -q "RedirectPermanent /$point_release" \
-		"$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/.htaccess"; then
+		"$SIMPLE_ROOT/.htaccess"; then
 		echo "RedirectPermanent /$point_release https://old-releases.ubuntu.com/releases/$point_release" \
-			>> "$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/.htaccess"
+			>> "$SIMPLE_ROOT/.htaccess"
 	fi
-	grep "${1}-" "$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/$relname/.htaccess" \
+	grep "${1}-" "$SIMPLE_ROOT/$relname/.htaccess" \
 		>> "$OLD_RELEASES/$relname/.htaccess"
-	sed -i -e"/${1}-/d" "$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/$relname/.htaccess"
+	sed -i -e"/${1}-/d" "$SIMPLE_ROOT/$relname/.htaccess"
 fi
 
-if [ -h "$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/$1" ]; then
+if [ -h "$SIMPLE_ROOT/$1" ]; then
 	ln -s "$relname" "$OLD_RELEASES/$1"
-	rm "$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/$1"
+	rm "$SIMPLE_ROOT/$1"
 fi
 if ! [ -e "$OLD_RELEASES/$release" ]; then
 	ln -s "$relname" "$OLD_RELEASES/$release"
@@ -107,8 +120,8 @@ if [ "$release" = "$1" ]; then
 	ln -s "$relname" "$OLD_RELEASES/${release}.0"
 fi
 
-images_source="$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/$relname"
-images_source_pool="$CDIMAGE_SIMPLE/.pool"
+images_source="$SIMPLE_ROOT/$relname"
+images_source_pool="$SIMPLE_ROOT/.pool"
 images_dest="$OLD_RELEASES/$relname"
 images_dest_pool="$OLD_RELEASES/.pool"
 
@@ -120,11 +133,17 @@ for file in "$images_source_pool"/*"$1"-*; do
 		continue
 	fi
 	mv "$file" "$images_dest_pool"/
-	symlink="$$images_source/$(basename "$file")"
-	mv "$symilnk" "$images_dest"/
+	symlink="$images_source/$(basename "$file")"
+	mv "$symlink" "$images_dest"/
 	case $file in *.img|*.img.xz|*.iso)
-		mv_checksum $images_base $images_source_pool $images_dest_pool
-		mv_checksum $images_base $images_source $images_dest
+		# mv_checksum matches "*$image." in SHA256SUMS, so it wants the
+		# name without its extension.
+		images_base=$(basename "$file")
+		images_base=${images_base%.iso}
+		images_base=${images_base%.img}
+		images_base=${images_base%.img.xz}
+		mv_checksum "$images_base" "$images_source_pool" "$images_dest_pool"
+		mv_checksum "$images_base" "$images_source" "$images_dest"
 		;;
 	esac
 done
